blockers.description: gpt-5.5 intermittently returns content=None with reasoning_content only. Mitigated with 5 retries + reasoning_effort auto-strip + token scaling, but still happens on ~10% of 1-image calls.
blockers.workaround: Extended retry (5 validation + 3 transport = 15 total). Phase 4 Oracle recovers after 4-5 retries. plan_intent still occasionally exhausts.

blockers.description: Model visually confuses Tomato for Apple when both are red and round. Planner sees Tomato on CounterTop, assumes it's the Apple, tries PickupObject(Apple), fails because Apple is inside Fridge.
blockers.workaround: Semantic memory's 'WHERE MY TARGET IS' section tells Planner the Apple was last seen inside Fridge. But Planner needs to actually USE this info.

decisions.decision: Default reasoning_effort to medium for all gpt-5.5 calls
decisions.rationale: xhigh multi-image returns content=None. Medium works for both text and images.

decisions.decision: Split memory into 3-layer architecture (interface + geometric + semantic)
decisions.rationale: Geometric preserves legacy behavior. Semantic adds receptacle grouping, freshness, task tracking. CLI --memory flag selects.

decisions.decision: Shift all system prompts to first-person 'I'
decisions.rationale: Egocentric memory describes what the agent itself experienced. Consistent with semantic memory's 'I saw...' format.

decisions.decision: Migrate API from api.fullcupai.com to www.9527code.com/v1
decisions.rationale: fullcupai relay had intermittent 400 'max_output_tokens' errors and rate limiting. 9527code returns clean responses with reasoning_len=0.

decisions.decision: Remove PickupObject Priority 4 fallback in action_adapter
decisions.rationale: Resolving Apple to invisible container-interior objectId caused 'target not found' errors with confusing diagnostics.

next_action: Start P2 Planner-level integration: make the Planner actually USE semantic memory's 'WHERE MY TARGET IS' section — when memory says 'Apple last seen inside Fridge', the Planner should output 'open Fridge' not 'approach CounterTop'.
